"""Test concurrent_create_conflict on /v1/schema/{className}"""
import requests, sys, time, uuid, threading, json

BASE = '{{TESTVDB_DB_URL}}'

# Create class first
c = 'TestConcCreate_' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]

payload = {
    "class": c,
    "vectorizer": "none",
    "vectorIndexConfig": {
        "distance": "cosine",
        "efConstruction": 128,
        "maxConnections": 32,
        "dynamicEfMin": 100,
        "dynamicEfMax": 500,
        "dynamicEfFactor": 8,
        "cleanupIntervalSeconds": 300,
        "flatSearchCutoff": 40000
    },
    "replicationConfig": {"factor": 1},
    "multiTenancyConfig": {"enabled": False},
    "properties": [{"name": "text", "dataType": ["text"]}]
}

r = requests.post(f'{BASE}/v1/schema', json=payload)
print(f'Create class: {r.status_code}')
if r.status_code == 200:
    print('Class created successfully')
    # Try creating the same class again - should fail with 422
    r2 = requests.post(f'{BASE}/v1/schema', json=payload)
    print(f'Duplicate create: {r2.status_code}')
    if r2.status_code == 200:
        print('[DEFECT: ILLEGAL_SUCCESS] Duplicate class creation should be rejected!')
        sys.exit(1)
    elif r2.status_code in [422, 409, 400]:
        print(f'Correctly rejected duplicate: {r2.status_code} {r2.text[:200]}')
    else:
        print(f'Unexpected status: {r2.status_code} {r2.text[:200]}')
    
    # Clean up
    requests.delete(f'{BASE}/v1/schema/{c}')
    print('Cleanup done')
else:
    print(f'Failed to create class: {r.status_code} {r.text[:300]}')

sys.exit(0)
